clamp: Two rigid annular platens per strip with Coulomb friction; bottom platen 750 N then locked Z position
degree: battery translations except UX and all rotations free; rigid end attachments
load_protocol: Step1 750 N per washer; step2 KBC=1 transfer to locked UZ at UX=0 and held battery; step3 KBC=0 pull with other battery DOFs free
retained_physics: same 750 N preload, locked platens, mu=0.2, free five other battery DOFs
fracture_definition: Native continuous damage only; no element deletion. Near-complete damage is not geometric severance.
